Package smart_food_delivery.service

Class PricingService

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.service.PricingService
public class PricingService extends Object
Handles order pricing and final bill calculation in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. This service applies a pricing strategy, calculates delivery costs, and handles additional express fees. It also prevents changes to orders that have already been delivered, cancelled, or paid.

  • Method Details

    • calculateFinalBill

      public double calculateFinalBill(Order order, PricingStrategy strategy, double distance)
      Calculates the final bill for an order. The calculation includes the food subtotal, pricing strategy adjustments, delivery costs, and any applicable express delivery fee. ExpressPricing adds a fixed fee of 10 to the food subtotal. When it is used with ExpressOrder, the express fee must also equal 10 to avoid charging the customer twice. The calculated delivery distance, delivery fee, and final bill are saved in the order.
      Parameters:
      order - the order to calculate the bill for
      strategy - the pricing strategy to apply
      distance - the delivery distance in kilometers
      Returns:
      the final bill amount
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order, pricing strategy, express fee, or calculated amount is invalid
      IllegalStateException - if the order has been delivered, cancelled, or already paid
